title: Sheet copper.
officialText:
Sheet copper shall conform to ASTM B 152 and shall not weight less than 12 ounces per square foot (3.7
kg/m2). The copper sheet shall be insulated from conducting substances other than the connecting drain by 15-pound (6.80 kg)
asphalt felt or its equivalent. Sheet copper shall be joined brazing or soldering.
